transform_audio_transcription_request: transform an audio transcription request from OpenAI format to Deepgram binary data
transform_audio_transcription_response: transform a Deepgram API response into OpenAI-compatible TranscriptionResponse format
get_complete_url: build the complete Deepgram /v1/listen URL with model and query parameters
validate_environment: validate the Deepgram environment and return Authorization headers with API key
reconstruct_diarized_transcript: reconstruct a diarized transcript from word-level data with speaker labels
